title: S9 Release procedure
description: RELEASING.md per references/release.md, CHANGELOG.md, package.json version; cut a release in round 3 if green.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASING.md + CHANGELOG.md committed; round 3 annotated tag pushed if all suites green.

title: S8 Bugs and mutants
description: Red commit then fix commit per bug; mutants (colour Medium=Low, light palette dropped, Alt+P meta guard dropped, Shift+Tab capability check, inFlight) caught N/N recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Each bug bead has red sha and fix sha; mutants caught N/N in TESTING.md.
close_reason: Mutants caught 5/5: mediumIsLow (fast P-10 + e2e I-7), lightDropped (e2e I-7), metaGuardCtrl (fast P-04 contract after v1 proved a dead mutation), capabilityCheck (fast P-01 contract; e2e unreachable documented), inFlightGuard (unit + fast P-05). 5x flake loops green on seed 424242.

title: S7 Traceability TESTING.md
description: Table property -> test -> surface -> last result with seed, runs, versions. No silent skip.
acceptance_criteria: Every SPEC property maps to >=1 test with a recorded result.
close_reason: TESTING.md committed a8cf280: every property mapped to tests with seeds/counts/versions; no silent skips

title: S6 dsh-TUI real-process property tests
description: fast-check generated key sequences (BTab, M-p, plain p, typing, /permissions, Escape, restart) on Launchpad and chat in private tmux socket; invariants after each step; seed replay.
acceptance_criteria: >=25 sequences per surface per round green (or red commits for bugs); seeds logged.
close_reason: TUI property campaigns green 25/25 per surface (seed 20261011) + fast properties 9/9 at NUM_RUNS=1000 (seed 424242); committed 8982f70

title: S5 Web inertness Playwright property test
description: No web surface: Playwright fast-check test that real dsh web with the patched build present stays unaltered. FC_SEED/NUM_RUNS, screenshots on failure.
acceptance_criteria: test passes with logged seed; documented in TESTING.md.
close_reason: web.inertness.test.mjs green 25/25 on real dsh web (seed 20261011), committed a8cf280

title: S4 Vendor the rig
description: Copy rig.mjs and mock-llm.mjs from ~/nix-config/skills/new-dsh-plugin/scripts into test/rig with source commit note; tmux -f /dev/null.
acceptance_criteria: test/rig/ committed with SOURCE note; tests import relatively; no ~/.agents imports.
close_reason: test/rig committed (1f17cfc + flag-injection fix 8d2defa); tests import relatively; SOURCE.md notes

title: S3 Nix environment flake.nix
description: packages.default (version from package.json), devShells.default (node, tmux, chromium via playwright-driver.browsers, beads, pinned dsh+dsh-TUI), checks (fast suites in sandbox), apps.e2e. Inputs pinned by rev; nix-dsh at nix-config rev f0ca0d7.
acceptance_criteria: nix flake check passes; nix run .#e2e runs real-client suites; flake.lock committed.
close_reason: flake.nix committed 97adab4 + checks.fast glob fix a8cf280; nix flake check passes (fast check 18/18 in sandbox); packages dsh/base/patched/standalone build with 9/9 install checks; e2e app + devShell present; flake.lock committed

title: S2 SPEC.md with stable property IDs
description: Collect every property from README, nix-config README, test/omp-keys.test.mjs, patch comments, and audit findings into SPEC.md with P-xx IDs, oracle and surface. Web surface not applicable rationale.
acceptance_criteria: SPEC.md committed; every README/test claim maps to an ID; web N/A rationale + inertness property present.
close_reason: SPEC.md committed (74c708f/8982f70): P-01..P-10, I-1..I-7, oracle, surfaces, web N/A rationale

title: S1 Source reconcile with nix-config deployed copy
description: Make main contain the deployed code: compare patches/ and test/ with ~/nix-config/pkgs/dsh-omp-keys (dsh-tui-0.14.0.patch, test/) as applied in pkgs/dsh-tui.nix after launchpad-word-edit.patch.
acceptance_criteria: Byte-compare recorded; any difference committed as a sync; both patch variants verified to apply to their stated bases.
close_reason: Byte-compares identical (patch, tests, launchpad patch, lockfile); both patch variants apply to their bases, proven by patched+standalone builds with 9/9 install checks

title: Spec-driven real-client test system, Nix env and release procedure
description: Ralph loop (3 rounds) requested by Jake via the Team Lead: SPEC.md with property IDs, flake (package/devShell/checks/e2e app), vendored rig, real dsh-TUI property tests, web inertness, traceability, bug red/green, mutants, SemVer release.
